title: InfiniCube: Unbounded and Controllable Dynamic 3D Driving Scene Generation with World-Guided Video Models
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: 3D scene: unbounded voxel world lifted to dynamic 3D Gaussians, plus long driving video (200 frames) and renderable views

control_signal.value: HD map, 3D vehicle bounding boxes with trajectories, and text prompts (e.g. weather, time of day).

control_mechanism.value: Map-conditioned voxel diffusion with outpainting; voxel world rendered into pixel-aligned guidance buffers (semantic, coordinate) conditioning the video model; text via a FLUX-based ControlNet producing the first frame from semantic buffers.

base_model.value: 25-frame SVD-XT video model fine-tuned at 576x1024; fVDB sparse 3D diffusion for voxels; FLUX ControlNet; dual-branch (voxel and pixel) feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction.

datasets.value: Waymo Open Dataset; 618 training and 90 evaluation sequences; weather and time-of-day captions made with Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct.

metrics.value: FID over frame index for long video, human-study positive rate for HD map alignment, and PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS for novel view rendering.

controllability_evidence.value: User study of HD map alignment at frames 40, 80, 120: positive rates 84.6%, 83.9%, 84.8% versus Panacea 76.8%, 54.0%, 53.4%; 180 samples per frame index.

closed_loop.value: No policy rollout. Video extended to 200 frames from the 25-frame model; free driving inside the generated 3DGS scene is claimed, scene about 100 000 m2.

stated_limitations.value: Consistency among long-distance voxel chunks may decline; future work on global consistency and more diverse training data.

notes: Table pairing of user-study numbers (ours vs Panacea) inferred from garbled table layout. Not an ego-action-conditioned model.
